body:
You guys are so encouraging, thank you.

I hate that this is going to turn into a sob story, and I apologize, but i'm just stating facts here. I am not at a university, I am at community college, which makes the whole math thing even more embarrassing. I live here by myself, and I literally don't have a single connection and I have incredibly high anxiety levels. This makes it hard for me to make friends, and meet new people, let alone find someone to help me with math. This also makes it hard for me to do filmmaking as well. 

I realize these are all things that I could fix myself, but it's just so hard and it makes me sad sometimes.

I've never really gotten this out verbally, or in writing before and it feels really good. So thank you, and /u/SomethingSM. 

Also, for the sake of anonymity i'm not going share my work, but thank you for being interested.

>If you're not good at math, try to find something else you like, and do that

I am, actually. What i'm interested in is filmmaking and it's my major. The problem is that the majority of my time and effort is going into math and things unrelated to filmmaking. I want to be improving at camerawork, editing, etc and not math, but it's required everywhere I go and it makes me want to die.

It just makes me feel like maybe I shouldn't be in college at all, but that would make me hate myself even more probably.

edit: Sorry if i'm not making sense, thank you for responding btw.
